controles.affirmation: 1,0 Md $ de charges legales sur le S1 2026, 842 M$ au T2, contre 564 M$ au S1 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : « charges for certain legal matters of $842 million and $1.0 billion for the second quarter and the first six months of 2026, respectively » ; « Earnings in the first six months of 2025 included [...] charges for certain legal matters of $564 million »

controles.affirmation: Zantac : majorite substantielle des dossiers d'Etat regles ou en voie de l'etre en mai 2026
controles.verbatim_source: « As of May 2026, Pfizer had settled, or entered into definitive agreements or agreements-in-principle to settle, subject to certain conditions, a substantial majority of the cases filed in state courts »

controles.affirmation: Depo-Provera : accord de principe en juin 2026 sur la majorite des dossiers MDL ; procedures d'Etat ouvertes en Californie, Connecticut, Delaware, New York
controles.verbatim_source: « In June 2026, we reached an agreement-in-principle with plaintiff leadership in the Depo-Provera MDL that we expect to resolve a substantial majority of the pending MDL cases on terms that are not material [...] coordinated proceedings were established in several U.S. state jurisdictions, including California, Connecticut, Delaware, and New York »

controles.affirmation: Pfizer ecrit que des verdicts excessifs surviennent et qu'un reglement peut avoir un effet significatif sur ses resultats et sa tresorerie
controles.verbatim_source: « litigation is inherently unpredictable and excessive verdicts do occur [...] we could incur judgments, enter into settlements [...] which could have a material adverse effect on our results of operations and/or our cash flows »

controles.affirmation: IRA/MFP : prix administre Eliquis en vigueur au 1er janvier 2026, Ibrance et Xtandi en 2027, aucun MFP pour Xeljanz
controles.verbatim_source: « its government-set Maximum Fair Price (MFP) which became effective for Eliquis on January 1, 2026. Negotiated prices for Ibrance and Xtandi are effective in 2027 [...] no MFP for Xeljanz will be finalized or take effect »

controles.affirmation: Accord definitif et contraignant avec l'administration americaine ; tarif Section 232 nul jusqu'au 20 janvier 2029 ; remises jusqu'a 85 % et 50 % en moyenne
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q : « We have reached final binding agreements with the U.S. Government [...] the applicable tariff rate under the April 2, 2026 Section 232 Executive Order for Pfizer products will be zero until January 20, 2029 » ; 10-K FY2025 : « savings that will range as high as 85% and on average 50% »

controles.affirmation: Eliquis : brevet de composition expirant en novembre 2026, generiques transiges au 1er avril 2028, lancement possible des le 21 novembre 2026 si invalidation
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : « permitting their launch of a generic version of Eliquis on April 1, 2028 » ; « the settled generic companies and any successful future litigant would be permitted to launch on November 21, 2026 »
